ch.n: Boat drop at 08:00, then birch forest an
ch.chars: Boat drop at 08:00, then birch forest and the first moraine. Short day to check boots and packs.

ch.n: Up the Fastdal glacier on a rope, crampo
ch.chars: Up the Fastdal glacier on a rope, crampons from the first ice. Night in a self-service hut.

ch.n: Summit day. Exposed ridge to point 1520,
ch.chars: Summit day. Exposed ridge to point 1520, turnaround at 13:00 whatever the weather looks like.

ch.n: Long descent on old snow, then the first
ch.chars: Long descent on old snow, then the first river crossing on foot. Sauna at the lake.

ch.n: Coastal path under the cliffs. This is a
ch.chars: Coastal path under the cliffs. This is also the spare day if the ridge was closed.

ch.n: Last ridge, last view, boat back across
ch.chars: Last ridge, last view, boat back across the fjord at 17:30.

ch.n: Two guides, huts, food and both fjord bo
ch.chars: Two guides, huts, food and both fjord boats are in the price. Crampons, axe and harness can be rented at the hut in Lyngseidet.
